summary: Risk-off pre-market: META and TSLA earnings reignite AI-spending worries (Meta reports $825B of future spending commitments), LRCX -7% after its report, chips -3.5%, oil above $112 on Iran; SPY -0.9%, QQQ -1.6%. Lean put, low confidence because yields fall and gap-downs often get bought. Sniper UNH call: Mizuho target $500 in the sector money is moving into.
reasons: SPY 766.00 pre-market vs 773.09 close (-0.9%); QQQ -1.6%; SMH -3.5%; IWM -0.6%. Nasdaq-100 futures about -1.6% to -1.9% (CNBC live blog, Stocktwits)

Driver: AI spending reassessed after META (-2.5%, Bloomberg: $825B in future spending commitments) and TSLA (-3.5%) reported; LRCX -7% after its report; INTC -5.1%, AMD -4.5%, MU -3.7%, AVGO -3.3%, ORCL -2.4%, NVDA -2.4%, AMZN -2.0%, GOOGL -1.7%; CRWV/NBIS -5%

Oil up: USO +1.9%, Brent above $112 on Iran tensions (headwind). Yields down: TLT +1.0% (flight to safety, a cushion). Dollar flat (UUP +0.1%). Not every macro input is aligned for a put (yields falling), hence low confidence
Defensives up: XLV +0.8% (LLY +1.3%, UNH +0.9%), XLE +1.0%. Rotation out of AI hardware into health care and energy continues

Rebound_scanner universe: >= 2% gap-downs in INTC, AMD, MU, AVGO, NVDA, ORCL, AMZN (META and TSLA are earnings reactions). Thursday: most single stocks have no same-day expiry. nvda_gapdown_put can fire (NVDA -2.4%)

Sniper UNH call: Mizuho raised its target to $500 (08:12), UNH +0.9% pre-market at 420.78, health care is the hottest sector (UNH +5.4% 1w, +11.8% 1m; LLY +5.1% 1w). A target raise is a weaker catalyst, but it points where money is moving on a risk-off day (the 10-14/15 lesson). Friday expiry (10-23) is the nearest. No UNH headline against it found in the last 24 hours

Not picked: META (many target raises but it is the earnings reaction day), TSLA (earnings reaction), PLTR (Citi target raise, but AI software into an AI selloff), V (Axios: in talks to buy Fireblocks for ~$2.5B; acquirer, direction unclear), GOOGL (Citizens target cut), any chip put (already -2% to -5%, chasing)
